name: OpenCode + NVIDIA Nemotron in NVIDIA OpenShell
description: Code-server IDE with OpenCode running in an NVIDIA OpenShell sandbox on local NVIDIA Nemotron models. The sandbox has no credentials and, by default, no network access except the local models; its policy is user-editable. Defaults to Lightning 30B on A100/H100, or experimental Nano 4B on T4/V100.
